INSERT INTO TC_EXCHANGE_RATE ( ID, RATE_DATE, BASE_CURRENCY, TARGET_CURRENCY, RATE_TYPE, EXCHANGE_RATE, BUY_RATE, SELL_RATE, CASH_BUY_RATE, CASH_SELL_RATE, MIDDLE_RATE, DATA_SOURCE, SOURCE_SYSTEM, PUBLISH_TIME, EFFECTIVE_TIME, EXPIRE_TIME, IS_CROSS_RATE, CROSS_CALCULATION_PATH, STATUS, REMARK, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME, CREATE_USER, UPDATE_USER, VERSION_NO ) VALUES
( #{item.id,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.rateDate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{item.baseCurrency,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.targetCurrency,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.rateType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.exchangeRate,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.buyRate,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.sellRate,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.cashBuyRate,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.cashSellRate,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.middleRate,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.dataSource,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.sourceSystem,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.publishTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{item.effectiveTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{item.expireTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{item.isCrossRate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.crossCalculationPath,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.status,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.createTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{item.updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{item.createUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.versionNo,jdbcType=INTEGER} )

update.foreach: UPDATE TC_EXCHANGE_RATE SET EXCHANGE_RATE = #{item.exchangeRate,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, BUY_RATE = #{item.buyRate,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, SELL_RATE = #{item.sellRate,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, CASH_BUY_RATE = #{item.cashBuyRate,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, CASH_SELL_RATE = #{item.cashSellRate,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, MIDDLE_RATE = #{item.middleRate,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, DATA_SOURCE = #{item.dataSource,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SOURCE_SYSTEM = #{item.sourceSystem,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, PUBLISH_TIME = #{item.publishTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, EFFECTIVE_TIME = #{item.effectiveTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, EXPIRE_TIME = #{item.expireTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, IS_CROSS_RATE = #{item.isCrossRate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CROSS_CALCULATION_PATH = #{item.crossCalculationPath,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, STATUS = #{item.status,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, REMARK = #{item.remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATE_TIME = #{item.updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, UPDATE_USER = #{item.updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, VERSION_NO = #{item.versionNo,jdbcType=INTEGER} WHERE ID = #{item.id,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
